about: Big boards for the Mock Draft Maker. College prospects carry espnCollegeAthleteId + collegeTeamId (verified against ESPN college rosters on 2026-11-14) so the app can pull live stats, measurables and headshots. High school / international prospects use type 'high_school' or 'international' and no ESPN ids; the UI shows an initials badge. 'height'/'weight' are fallbacks used when ESPN can't be reached. 'summary' and 'comp' are editorial notes — edit freely.

2027.name: Tyran Stokes
2027.summary: Big, strong wing who plays through contact and can create at multiple levels. Scouts will watch his perimeter shooting consistency and defensive engagement over a full season.

2027.name: Caleb Holt
2027.summary: Powerful downhill guard with the frame to finish through contact and defend multiple spots. Jump-shot volume and decision-making in the half court are the key swing skills.

2027.name: Bruce Branch III
2027.summary: Long, fluid forward with scoring versatility from the wing. Adding strength and proving his shot against high-major length will shape his range.

2027.name: Braylon Mullins
2027.summary: Sophomore shooting guard with size for the position and a track record from his freshman season at UConn. Movement shooting is the calling card; on-ball creation is the question.

2027.name: Nikola Kusturica
2027.summary: European-developed forward with feel as a connector: passes, cuts and spaces. Strength against college bigs and defensive range are the areas to track.

2027.name: Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje
2027.summary: Towering center with rim-protection upside and a big target in the pick-and-roll. Mobility in space and how much he can stretch his offensive game will set his ceiling.

2027.name: Quentin Coleman
2027.summary: Quick guard who can score in bunches and push the pace. Adding strength and showing he can run an offense against pressure will decide his draft range.
